title: Desktop files/folders dragged from one screen to another lose their arrangement and become alphabetically sorted in a line
line: Icons dragged together from one screen to another now keep their arrangement and order instead of landing in a row.
explanation: When icons were dropped on another screen, the target view only knew the drop point: each icon was queued as its own move to that same point. They collided and were pushed one cell to the right in turn, so any arrangement became a row, and an icon could also be pushed by another one that had not moved yet, which changed their order. The change takes each icon's offset from the cursor from the screen the drag started on, scales it from that screen's grid (cell size and the icon's vertical hit point) to the target's, and moves all icons of the drop together in one positioner move.

commits.message:
foldermodel: keep the arrangement of icons dropped on another screen

Icons dragged to another screen were each moved on their own to the
drop point and bumped into each other, ending up in a row. Keep their
offsets from the cursor, scaled to the new grid, and move them at once.

BUG: 481807

media.caption: Master, two screens: a 2x2 square selected on the left screen and dragged by m1 to the right screen lands as a row.
With the fix, same steps: the square stays a square, with the dragged icon under the cursor.
Master: a vertical column of four icons dragged to the other screen becomes a horizontal row.
With the fix: the column stays a column in the same order.
